steps.title: Break ground
steps.instruction: Tap DRILL in the BUILD PALETTE, then tap revealed ground beside the Core.

steps.title: Lay pipe
steps.instruction: Tap RESEARCH, then tap POWER GRID. Ore only moves along conduits.

steps.title: Connect the drill
steps.instruction: Tap CONDUIT, then drag from the Core to the Drill (or tap each grid tile).

steps.title: Think faster
steps.instruction: Tap SERVER BANK, then tap revealed ground to build it.

steps.title: Stop borrowing power
steps.instruction: Tap WIND TURBINE, then tap revealed ground. Mountains give it a bonus.

steps.title: Cut faster
steps.instruction: Tap RESEARCH, then tap EFFICIENT DRILLS. More ore makes the rail arrive sooner.

steps.title: Make room on the grid
steps.instruction: Tap RESEARCH, then tap POWER EFFICIENCY. The rail needs room on the grid.

steps.title: Prepare the launch rail
steps.instruction: Tap RESEARCH, then tap MASS DRIVER. The next world needs a live rail.

steps.title: Build the launch rail
steps.instruction: Tap MASS DRIVER, then tap revealed ground beside the Core.
